events.verdict: Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Claxton (BKN) is in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Connaughton (MIL) establishes a screening position in Claxton's (BKN) path and brings two hands to Claxton's body before releasing as the pick is set.
Johnson (BKN) grazes Antetokounmpo's (MIL) body as he attempts to avoid making contact during the dunk. Any contact that occurs is marginal.
Beauchamp (MIL) and Claxton (BKN) briefly engage and disengage in an attempt to pursue the loose ball as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Claxton (BKN) collapses his arms as he absorbs the incoming contact from Connaughton (MIL) as he sets the pick.
Beauchamp (MIL) brings his hand to Johnson's (BKN) arm as the contact that occurs is marginal and does not affect Johnson's control of the ball.
Johnson (BKN) gathers the ball and establishes his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains prior to releasing the pass.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) and Johnson (BKN) make clean contact to the loose ball as both players pursue the rebound.
Claxton (BKN) jumps alongside Lillard's (MIL) path as the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Lillard (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Lillard makes clean contact to the ball as he deflects it away from Wilson (BKN) during the drive.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Wilson (BKN) prior to it going out of bounds.
Connaughton (MIL) collapses his arms as he absorbs the incoming contact from Johnson (BKN) as the screen is set.

Claxton (BKN) moves alongside of Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path to the basket and the body contact that occurs is marginal. Claxton then reaches in, but retracts his arm away from Antetokounmpo to legally contest the shot attempt at the basket.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) commits a take foul on Williams (BKN).
A delay of game warning is correctly assessed to BKN prior to the second free throw attempt.
Wilson (BKN) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Middleton (BKN) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Williams (BKN) does not establish position inbounds prior to receiving the pass.
